title: 2025 Consumer Response Annual Report
discussion_signal: The post highlights 6.6 million CFPB complaints in 2025, concentration in credit reporting, and timely company responses to more than 99% of complaints sent for review. It also notes that complaint volume may be polluted by credit-repair firms, influencers, and AI-generated submissions. This creates a measurement tension: high response rates can coexist with uncertain consumer authenticity, resolution quality, and recovery.
linked_research_question: When complaint volume rises and automated or intermediary submissions increase, how can researchers distinguish consumer harm, institutional response, and actual remedy?
limits: Timely company response does not prove correction or consumer satisfaction
The post summarizes a report and does not independently validate the attribution of complaint volume
Complaint counts are not prevalence estimates of all consumer harm
